# Vendored browser libraries

The application serves these pinned files locally so the portfolio demo does not
depend on a public CDN at runtime.

| File | Project | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lightweight-charts-5.0.6.min.js` | TradingView Lightweight Charts | 5.0.6 | Apache-2.0 | <https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts> |
| `echarts-6.1.0.min.js` | Apache ECharts | 6.1.0 | Apache-2.0 | <https://github.com/apache/echarts> |

The unmodified distribution files retain their upstream banner notices. See each
upstream repository for the complete Apache License 2.0 text and notices.
